name: Dr. Colledge's original Hospital at Macao
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A drawing of the south-western part of the peninsula of Macau, showinga  group of small buildings; one of these (on the right) was used by the surgeon Thomas Richardson Colledge (1797-1879) as his 'ophthalmic hospital' for the treatment of Chinese patients.
